GANGSTAS PARADISE (Sleeper) — Nothing new since Saturday afternoon; Tuten's Q tag is gone, Higgins/Flowers/Downs still Q, first real reports Wed
Do now: nothing — lineup is set
Locks next 24h: none — nothing you own plays before Sun 10:00 AM PT (opp's Henderson plays Wed 5:20 PM PT)
Lineup: no changes. Higgins (bruised heel) missed Wed+Thu but Taylor calls it minor — if Higgins is out, start Diggs. Flowers (quad) practiced Thu, on track — if Flowers is out, start Diggs. Downs (calf, "very minor") — if Downs is out, start Diggs; if two of the three are out, Diggs then Michael Wilson (@ LAC, 1:25 PT). Tuten's illness tag cleared on Sleeper; he stays at FLEX, JAX committee with Rodriguez/Allen is the only risk. Herbert, Hampton, Brown, Strange, Aubrey, JAX DEF: no news, all in.

GAME OF THROWS (Yahoo) — Lineup is set; three players lock before Sunday
Do now: nothing — lineup is set
Locks next 24h: none. Early locks: Myers Wed 5:20 PM PT (SEA vs NE); Stafford, 49ers DEF, Corum (bench) Thu 5:35 PM PT (SF @ LAR, Melbourne)
Lineup: no changes. Stafford was a full camp participant, no back flare-up. Etienne is the clear NO lead with Kamara (MCL) likely out — start him with confidence. Judkins is fully back from the Dec fibula surgery and stays at FLEX — if Judkins is out, start Michael Wilson (half PPR, a real WR2 beats a backup RB). Pickens, G. Wilson, P. Washington, Likely: no news. 49ers DEF @ LAR is still your weakest slot (4.32) — nothing to do until the Tuesday waiver run.

FYI: Chase Brown (both teams) is clean and gets more work if Chase/Higgins sit; Michael Wilson is your first non-Diggs option on both benches; four Jaguars across the two teams (Tuten, Strange, JAX DEF / P. Washington) and Judkins @ JAX collides with your JAX DEF. Sleeper opp AdufortheWin84 (proj 122.48 vs your 130.15, 56%) has Henderson (ankle) who missed Thu and Sat practice ahead of Wed night — Stevenson would start; CMC is fully healthy. Yahoo opp Arshdeep (115.41 vs 103.72) carries three Qs: Jeanty (ankle, HC optimistic), Nabers (knee, back in team drills), LaPorta (hip, practicing since Aug 25).
